text: What are you doing with Helen?” “Oh, dearest, do go away, and I will manage it all.” “Manage what?” He stretched out his hand for the keys. She might have obeyed if it had not been for the doctor. “Stop that at least,” she said piteously; the doctor had turned back, and was questioning the driver of Helen’s cab. A new feeling came over her; she was fighting for women against men. She did not care about rights, but if men came into Howards End, it should be over her body.
